These 2n dual extremes form a rank-(n−1) system whose unique one-dimensional relation has coefficient vector a. A dual isometry permutes their antipodal pairs and sends the positive circuit to a scalar circuit: all signs coincide and the normalized weight multiset is recovered. Converse ambient permutations and automorphism C2×∏S_{m_j}; dominant group signed permutations of n−1 axes.
